description.value: Lynn Valley Bikes is a full-service North Vancouver bike shop strategically located minutes from the trail networks of Mount Fromme and Mount Seymour on the North Shore. The shop runs a dedicated service centre staffed by experienced mechanics who handle everything from quick tune-ups to complete suspension rebuilds on trail, DH, road, and electric bikes. Touring cyclists will find a wide parts and accessories inventory, an active rental program, and a team that explicitly welcomes drop-in service visits.
